title: Sparkly submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water glow hints -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='44' ry='22' fill='#0d2b45'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe680'>
    <path d='M14 30 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M84 22 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M78 74 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z'/>
    <path d='M20 72 l1.4 3.5 l3.5 1.4 l-3.5 1.4 l-1.4 3.5 l-1.4 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.4 l3.5 -1.4 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#9fe8ff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='16' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='50' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='50' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='82' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='84' r='1.6'/>
  </g>
  <!-- hull -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='34' ry='16' fill='#f2b134'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='15' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- hull stripe -->
  <rect x='20' y='56' width='60' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e07a2f'/>
  <!-- conning tower -->
  <path d='M42 38 h16 v-10 a3 3 0 0 0 -3 -3 h-10 a3 3 0 0 0 -3 3 z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e07a2f'/>
  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='48' y='14' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8ad6e8'/>
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5fc3dd'/>
  <!-- portholes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='5' fill='#5fc3dd'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#c9f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='5' fill='#5fc3dd'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#c9f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='5' fill='#5fc3dd'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#c9f4ff'/>
  <!-- front light (red) -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ff5c5c'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='54' r='1.6' fill='#ffc2c2'/>
  <!-- propeller -->
  <g fill='#bfe8f5'>
    <ellipse cx='15' cy='46' rx='4' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-25 15 46)'/>
    <ellipse cx='15' cy='66' rx='4' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(25 15 66)'/>
    <ellipse cx='11' cy='56' rx='2.4' ry='4'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='16' cy='56' r='3' fill='#8ad6e8'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <g fill='#c9f4ff'>
    <circle cx='86' cy='36' r='2.6'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='28' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='22' r='1.4'/>
  </g>
</svg>
